P3.what: sleeve-level vol targeting before portfolio_v5: each sleeve's hourly P&L x clip(sd_365 / sd_w, 0.5, 2) of its own daily P&L, lagged one day (w = 30 or 60 days); like Gen221 in the futures book
P3.selection: the window with the higher 2022-24 book Sharpe (or none if neither beats the current)

P4.what: fixed neighbourhood ensembles (no selection): trend 4h = mean of the 8 P1 trend variants, delev bounce = mean of the 9 variants with threshold 0.08-0.12 and hold 1-3, alt kimchi = mean of the 4 P1 threshold sets; each alone and all three together
P4.flag: FLAGGED post hoc: the variants' results were seen in P1
P4.judge: strict rule on the full book: >= 3.211 + 0.05 and no period lower
